recommendations.description: Conduct a joint policy audit for Medicaid TANF Standard prior-authorized ACUTE HOSPITAL admissions, starting in MO and extending to CA, FL, KS, MD, OH, NC, LA, and NY, to review UM KPI performance, validate authorization-to-claim matching and denial enforcement, and confirm claims are processing per contractual obligation for postpartum/postabortion, pneumothorax, major bowel, and cranial/peripheral nerve DRGs at provider level.
evidence: MO authorized acute hospital claims increased about $28.6M.
MO admissions increased by 887 and paid per admit rose about $1.4K.
CA, FL, KS, MD, and OH added about $3.9M.
Postpartum, pneumothorax, bowel, and nerve DRGs recur across affected markets.
All source groups show pa_required_code equals Y.
Mercy Hospital Saint Louis appears in MO drill context.
peer_benchmarking: BCBS_KC: conditional separate postpartum payment for OB codes 59400, 59510, 59610, 59618, 59410, 59515, 59614, 59622.
Centene: no applicable OB code interactions identified for the requested postpartum DRG pattern.

evidence: MO Not Mapped TANF Standard claims increased about $7.6M, with 446 more admissions.
DC Not Mapped TANF Standard claims increased about $5.2M, with 119 more admissions.
DC ABD Non Dual and CHIP Standard added about $0.9M combined.
SENTARA NORFOLK GENERAL HOSPITAL and SAINT THOMAS WEST HOSPITAL appear in provider-concentrated settings.
peer_benchmarking: Centene bundles many ancillary institutional items into high-acuity inpatient stay charges.
Molina applies all-inclusive room, panel, and operating-room billing rules.
United Health bundles routine facility services with no separate reimbursement.

recommendations.description: Launch an IN Rehabilitation with CC/MCC review for PA-required Physical Rehab and CHILDRENS admissions tied to aftercare, weakness, other malaise, and traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage; confirm prior authorization was obtained and matched actual claims, audit CUMG nurse and MD approval and denial pathways plus initial and concurrent review KPIs, and validate contractually correct reimbursement with itemized bill review for pediatric rehab claims.
evidence: IN aftercare rehab at Riley's Children's Health added $2.9M and 104 admissions.

Procedures, Craniotomy and Endovascular Intracranial Procedures with MCC, Spinal Fusion Except Cervical with Spinal Curvature, Malignancy, Infection or Extensive Fusions with MCC, Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours with MCC, and Not Mapped DRGs; verify final claim adjudication, authorization enforcement, and DRG assignment.

recommendations.description: Implement a focused CA maternity inpatient utilization policy review for TANF Standard acute-hospital episodes in Postpartum and Postabortion Diagnoses without O.R. Procedures, centered on UNIVERSITY OF MARYLAND MEDICAL CENTER and diagnoses SEVERE PRE-ECLAMP COMP PUERPERIUM, OTH MENTAL D/O COMP PUERPERIUM, and PUERPERAL SEPSIS, to confirm prior authorization, reconcile authorized versus paid level of care, screen for repeat postpartum admissions, test provider unit-cost variation, and route affected members to targeted postpartum case management.
evidence: CA maternity complications increased total paid by about $2.4M.
SEVERE PRE-ECLAMP COMP PUERPERIUM had more admissions and higher paid per admit.
OTH MENTAL D/O COMP PUERPERIUM showed sharply higher paid per admit.
PUERPERAL SEPSIS admissions increased in CA postpartum acute hospital cases.
Postpartum source cards show pa_required_code Y and er_admit_indicator Y.
Top postpartum source cards share UNIVERSITY OF MARYLAND MEDICAL CENTER context.
